extraction.Name: John Wright
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded August 30, 1922 by D. A. Sinclair.
extraction.Buyer: Land contract between Wright and Alden B. Chittenden dated June 21, 1924, whereby Wright agrees to sell to Chittenden for $4800; $1500 in cash, the remainder in four annual installments. On January 28, 1926, Wright deeded the land to Chittenden for $4800 subject to the mortgage of $2500. Chittenden assumes the mortgage to Abrahams.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739707 issued. West half of section 8, township 96, north of range 77. Land mortgaged August 24, 1922 by Wright to Henry J. Abrahams for $2500. Also mortgaged by Wright to B. G. Zeitner October 12, 1921, for $1229.30. The Zeitner mortgage was released September 19, 1922. No receipt shown for patent.
